english.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday word for a protective mask worn over the nose and mouth.

exampleSentences.english: I usually wear a mask when I go out to protect myself and others.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我出街通常都會戴口罩，保護自己同人哋。
